purpose: Freeze the external atmosphere and cloud-QC evidence hierarchy before target twilight radiance values are opened, using co-located Izaña lidar to constrain temporal stability while explicitly refusing to invent a post-hoc AOD-age threshold.

frozenAsivAodSupport.sessionAdmissionRule: final independently derived AOD550 uncertainty/support interval must lie wholly inside [0.05,0.40]; do not admit a session whose plausible atmosphere crosses the frozen model boundary
frozenAsivAodSupport.reason: Izaña often experiences pristine AOD below 0.05, so visually clean conditions are not automatically in-domain validation conditions

primaryQuantitativeAodAnchor.source: AERONET Version 3 Solar AOD Level 2.0 at Izana
primaryQuantitativeAodAnchor.reason: Version 3 Level 2.0 applies automatic cloud/instrument QC plus pre-field and post-field calibrations and is the quality-assured solar AOD product.

aod550Derivation.method: Angstrom interpolation from independently measured AERONET spectral AOD

primaryQuantitativeAodAnchor.knownVisibleFieldInstrumentUncertaintyCo: published AERONET field-instrument AOD uncertainty is commonly about 0.01-0.02 in visible channels, larger toward UV; the final validation contract must use source/product-specific uncertainty rather than silently adopting this contextual range as a universal sigma

independentDaylightCorroboration.role: independent daylight AOD corroboration and calibration/stability diagnostic
independentDaylightCorroboration.publishedChannelUncertaintyContext: approximately 0.004 at 862 nm to 0.01 at 368 nm
independentDaylightCorroboration.publishedTraceabilityContext: long-term synchronous Izaña comparison found AERONET-Cimel and GAW-PFR highly traceable, especially outside the shortest UV channel

roles.AER: aerosol heights/profiles and lidar-derived AOD at times between sun/lunar photometer observations
roles.CLD: cloud heights/properties including thin-cloud extinction/optical-depth and cloud phase

levelPreference.strictFinalPreference: L2 where obtainable before target-radiance opening

coLocatedLidarEvidence.dependencyCaveat: MPLNET AER uses AERONET sun/lunar photometer AOD in calibration/retrieval and treats lunar AOD with lower confidence; it is therefore not an independent replacement for the AERONET solar Level 2 absolute AOD anchor.

aeronetLunarV3.reason: published assessments describe lunar Level 1.5 AOD as provisional/not yet quality-assured and note weaker cirrus rejection at night

otherNighttimePhotometry.note: historical Izaña lunar/star-photometer intercomparisons support feasibility of nocturnal AOD, but no current independent per-session product has yet been bound as required truth for this validation

cloudAndGlareQc.solarAodCloudQc: AERONET Version 3 Level 2.0 automatic cloud screening and instrument anomaly QC applies to the AOD anchor itself

coLocatedVerticalCloudVeto.role: reject a twilight observation when the co-located vertical lidar identifies cloud contamination under the preregistered synchronization rule

primaryIndependentWholeSkyContext.historicalSystemCapability: automated visible/infrared all-sky imaging day and night with cloud-fraction algorithms
primaryIndependentWholeSkyContext.role: whole-sky cloud/glare context independent of Pandora target radiance

cloudAndGlareQc.combinedPrinciple: MPLNET CLD and SONA are complementary: a cloud detection by either may trigger rejection under the frozen rule; lack of detection by only one source is not sufficient to establish a clear session.

bsrn.role: independent radiation/context diagnostic where synchronized data are available
